thread:
marie: Following the postmortem, here's the consolidated DR / regional failover action list. I made owners and target dates — we need updates by EOD Fri.

marie: ACTION 1 — Multi-region routing: add health-weighted failover + sanity checks in control plane. Owner: @aj. Target: 2024-05-10. Risk: config drift between regions.

aj: Got it. I'll add a playbook and a PR for the routing-service. ETA looks OK but need a quick dependency check on cross-region DNS TTLs.

devin: For DNS TTLs note that we have a global edge layer; reducing to 30s may spike load during failover. Recommend canary first.

marie: Good call @devin — add canary rollout step. aj, include rollback plan and cost estimate for spike.

marie: ACTION 2 — Backups: verify cross-region backups and periodic restore tests. Owner: @sara. Target: 2024-05-03. Must include snapshot retention matrix.

sara: I'll run a full verify against last 3 snapshots this week, and post results in this thread. Also adding a checklist for restore prerequisites (VPC peering, IAM roles).

ops-bot: scheduled: restore-test job queued for 2024-04-26 02:00 UTC. Job id: rtest-20240426-1

liam: For DB restores, please ensure point-in-time restore windows are documented. We hit a retention limit during last incident.

sara: @liam noted. Adding PITR windows and deviation steps for older snapshots.

marie: ACTION 3 — Restore runbooks: create step-by-step runbooks for region failover for prod, staging, and dev. Owner: @devin. Target: 2024-05-07. Include commands, IAM escalation, and estimated RTO.

devin: I'll convert the current pager runbook into a DR runbook and add a quick reference one-pager for first responders.

aj: Can we add a small automated smoke-test that runs post-restore? Something that hits /health + token auth flow.

devin: Yes — I'll add smoke-test script example and where to run it from (ci-runner in secondary region).

marie: ACTION 4 — Game day(s): run a tabletop then a full failover drill. Owner: @marie. Tabletop target: 2024-05-02, Full drill: 2024-05-16. Invite: SRE, Runtime, Platform, Support.

sara: I'll block calendar for restore owners and SRE. For the full drill, we should run it in a maintenance window and pre-warn customers.

aj: For the tabletop, propose we simulate a region network partition and test routing failover + DB restore path.

liam: Also test partial failures: control plane up, limited compute in region, and validate automatic fallback to dedicated capacity.

marie: ACTION 5 — Recurring incident pattern tracking: ops team to add tags for region, root-cause bucket, and automation gaps. Owner: @aj. Target: 2024-05-01. We'll report monthly.

aj: adding metrics to incident dashboard and a recurring ticket template for postmortem follow-ups.

marie: Quick asks: everyone respond with "ack" + any blockers by EOD. I'll run a short sync tomorrow to confirm owners and timelines.

devin: ack. No blockers from runtime side.

sara: ack — will post snapshot verification results tonight.

aj: ack — will start routing PR and draft canary plan.

liam: ack — I'll prepare the PITR doc and smoke test cases.

marie: Thanks all. Game day invites will go out after I get confirmation from leads. Any objections to the dates above, speak up now. :thumbsup:
